about: The long run. Batch B-4471 of B-4471 fire alarm tins, 2,400 tins, 40 parties over 10 simulated days: 5 on the shipment records, 21 stores found in the distributors' order systems, 14 named by forwarders (12 stores, one more store and Corner Mart). 36 are simulated parties with behaviour profiles; Harbour Market and Corner Mart answer real phones in the demo. Every store's tins are on_shelf at first and fixed two to four simulated days in. Ends with only the slice's tins open (15 disputed, 25 on_shelf and not fixed at Corner Mart), so the recall cannot close.

recall.hazard: The sounder circuit may fail to activate in an alarm
